title: Treaty of Waitangi
summary: On 6 February 1840 at Waitangi in the Bay of Islands, William Hobson and between 43 and 46 Maori rangatira (the Waitangi Tribunal's count; another source says about 50) signed the first copy of the treaty. Its Maori and English texts differ, notably over kawanatanga versus sovereignty, and the Crown later claimed sovereignty over New Zealand.

as_recorded.value: 6 February 1840, at Waitangi in the Bay of Islands
The first 50 chiefs signed at Waitangi on 6 February 1840.
